card.architecture: Krea 2 two-stage — RAW base (real CFG) renders structure, then Krea 2 Turbo does a partial-denoise latent polish (shared Qwen3-VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE); base is int8-ConvRot, Turbo is fp8 (bf16 is 26 GB). Models run sequentially — base offloads before Turbo loads — and both spill to system RAM, so it runs on an 8 GB GPU.
card.summary: Best-of-both Krea 2: the RAW base gives strong prompt adherence and composition at real CFG, then the distilled Turbo polishes texture and aesthetic over the base latent in a few steps. Tune 'Polish strength' for how much Turbo reworks the base.
use_cases: highest-quality Krea aesthetic (adherence of the base + polish of Turbo)
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 license for your use
card.pick_when: You want Krea 2's best quality and don't mind two passes: the base for adherence, Turbo for polish; runs on an 8 GB GPU (sequential load + RAM offload).

prompt.guidance: Descriptive natural-language prose; aesthetic/style words carry weight.
prompt.example: an editorial photograph of a ceramic vase on a sunlit table, soft film grain, muted earth tones, shallow depth of field
prompt.instructions: Write natural language; lean into style, lighting, and mood descriptors. Base: ~28 steps, CFG ~4, euler/simple. Polish: Turbo at cfg 1, ~8 steps, 'Polish strength' ~0.25-0.4 (higher redraws more). Native ~1K. Negative prompts affect the base pass (real CFG).
do: Lower Polish strength to keep the base composition; raise it to let Turbo redraw more
dont: Push Polish strength near 1.0 unless you want Turbo to redraw the image
prompt.negative_guidance: Applies to the base pass (real CFG ~4); keep it light. Ignored by the Turbo polish (cfg 1).

negative.note: Affects the base pass (real CFG ~4); the Turbo polish runs cfg 1 and ignores it.

speed.note: Two passes (28-step base + 8-step Turbo polish) with a base->Turbo model swap; the fp8 encoder offloads before the diffusion models load.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in plain words. 'Polish strength' controls how much the fast Turbo pass reworks the base render — low keeps the base, higher redraws more.
